# Parsi & Company, CPA

> Century City (Los Angeles) CPA firm providing tax preparation, bookkeeping, IRS dispute resolution, estate planning, and advisory services with personal, long-term guidance for individuals and business owners.

- [Insights](https://parsicocpa.com/insights): Educational articles on federal and California tax topics.
